quarterly_data.signal: Lam Research's fiscal 2026 10-K reports four unnamed customers accounting for approximately 16%, 15%, 12% and 12% of total revenues in fiscal 2026 (2025-06-30 to 2026-06-28), two customers at 17% and 15% in fiscal 2025, and one customer at 17% in fiscal 2024. Separately, the 10-K says its most significant customers during fiscal 2024-2026 included Micron Technology, Samsung Electronics, SK hynix and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, without assigning percentages to them.

Lam Research's 10-K XBRL revenue by product line lists Systems Revenue at $14.89B for fiscal year 2025-06-30 to 2026-06-28 (+29.5% YoY vs $11.49B) and Customer support-related revenue and other at $8.35B (+20.2% YoY vs $6.94B).
